plaintext_secrets_detected.title: Plaintext Secrets Detected
plaintext_secrets_detected.description: Whether plaintext passwords, API keys, tokens, or certificates are embedded directly in configuration manifests, playbooks, or state files rather than being referenced via a secrets manager or vault.

secrets_vault_or_encryption_in_use.title: Secrets Vault or Encryption in Use
secrets_vault_or_encryption_in_use.description: Whether secret values in configuration files are protected via an approved mechanism such as Ansible Vault, HashiCorp Vault references, AWS Secrets Manager references, SOPS encryption, or Kubernetes Secrets with encryption-at-rest.

api_authentication_enabled.title: API Authentication Enabled
api_authentication_enabled.description: Whether the configuration agent's management API requires authentication (e.g., token, certificate, or other credential) before accepting commands.

api_network_exposure.title: API Network Exposure
api_network_exposure.description: The network scope on which the configuration agent API listens — whether it is bound to localhost only, an internal network interface, or all interfaces.

tls_enforced.title: TLS Enforced on Agent API
tls_enforced.description: Whether the configuration agent API enforces TLS/mutual-TLS for all connections. When false, the API may accept plaintext connections, which can bypass certificate-based authentication and allow interception.

agent_runtime_user.title: Agent Runtime User
agent_runtime_user.description: The OS user account under which the configuration/deployment agent process runs (e.g., root, SYSTEM, ansible, puppet, chef-client).

agent_sudoers_unrestricted.title: Agent Has Unrestricted Sudo/Elevation Rights
agent_sudoers_unrestricted.description: Whether the deployment agent account has unrestricted sudo (Linux) or SeDebugPrivilege/local administrator membership (Windows) without command-level restrictions.

least_privilege_policy_applied.title: Least-Privilege Policy Applied to Agent Account
least_privilege_policy_applied.description: Whether a documented, enforced least-privilege policy scopes the agent account to only the specific OS capabilities, paths, or commands required for configuration management tasks.

signature_verification_enabled.title: Configuration Signature Verification Enabled
signature_verification_enabled.description: Whether the configuration management system enforces cryptographic signature verification before applying manifests, modules, or packages.

trusted_key_store_configured.title: Trusted Key Store Configured
trusted_key_store_configured.description: Whether a set of trusted public keys or a key store has been configured for verifying configuration content signatures.

unsigned_content_action.title: Action on Unsigned Content
unsigned_content_action.description: The action taken by the configuration management system when it encounters unsigned or unverified configuration content.

transport_protocol.title: Transport Protocol
transport_protocol.description: The protocol used for communication between the host agent and the central configuration server.

tls_enabled.title: TLS Enabled for Agent-Server Transport
tls_enabled.description: Whether TLS/SSL encryption is enabled for agent-to-server communication in the configuration management system.

certificate_verification_enabled.title: Certificate Verification Enabled
certificate_verification_enabled.description: Whether the agent validates the server's TLS certificate, preventing MITM attacks even when TLS is nominally in use.

drift_detection_enabled.title: Drift Detection Enabled
drift_detection_enabled.description: Whether the configuration management system has drift detection scheduled and active (e.g., Puppet agent runs, Chef client recurring execution, Ansible Tower scheduled jobs, or equivalent).

drift_remediation_mode.title: Drift Remediation Mode
drift_remediation_mode.description: How the system responds when configuration drift is detected: automatic enforcement, alert-only, or no action.

max_drift_check_interval_hours.title: Maximum Drift Check Interval (Hours)
max_drift_check_interval_hours.description: The maximum number of hours between scheduled drift detection or configuration enforcement runs across managed hosts.

drift_alerting_configured.title: Drift Alerting Configured
drift_alerting_configured.description: Whether alerts or notifications are configured to fire when drift is detected and not remediated (e.g., integration with SIEM, PagerDuty, or email notifications).

state_file_world_readable.title: State File World-Readable
state_file_world_readable.description: Whether any configuration state files (e.g., Puppet catalogs, Chef node cache, Ansible facts cache, Salt grains/pillar cache) have world-readable permissions, allowing any local user to read their contents.

sensitive_data_in_state_files.title: Sensitive Data Present in State Files
sensitive_data_in_state_files.description: The highest sensitivity class of data found within the world-readable state files, indicating the severity of the exposure.

state_file_owner_is_root.title: State File Owner Is Root
state_file_owner_is_root.description: Whether the world-readable state files are owned by root or a privileged system account, meaning normal processes wrote them with excess permissions.

audit_logging_enabled.title: Audit Logging Enabled
audit_logging_enabled.description: Whether the configuration management system has audit/event logging enabled for applied changes and agent runs.

logged_event_types.title: Logged Event Types
logged_event_types.description: List of event categories that are captured in logs (e.g., 'config_change', 'agent_run', 'deployment', 'error', 'auth_event').

log_retention_days.title: Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: Number of days that configuration change logs are retained before deletion or archival.

log_detail_level.title: Log Detail Level
log_detail_level.description: The granularity of detail captured in configuration change logs.

agent_version_has_known_cve.title: Agent Version Has Known CVE
agent_version_has_known_cve.description: Whether the installed configuration management agent version has one or more publicly disclosed CVEs with available exploits or patches.

days_since_last_agent_update.title: Days Since Last Agent Update
days_since_last_agent_update.description: Number of days elapsed since the configuration management agent binary was last updated or patched.

automatic_agent_updates_enabled.title: Automatic Agent Updates Enabled
automatic_agent_updates_enabled.description: Whether the system is configured to automatically apply updates to the configuration management agent.

source_urls_use_unverified_external_repo.title: Modules Sourced From Unverified External Repositories
source_urls_use_unverified_external_repo.description: Indicates whether the configuration system pulls modules, roles, or plugins from public repositories (e.g., Ansible Galaxy, Puppet Forge, Chef Supermarket) or arbitrary URLs without any restriction to an internal mirror or approved source list.

version_pinning_enforced.title: Module Version Pinning Enforced
version_pinning_enforced.description: Indicates whether every external module, role, or plugin dependency specifies an exact pinned version, preventing silent upgrades or dependency confusion substitution.

integrity_verification_method.title: Module Integrity Verification Method
integrity_verification_method.description: The method used to verify the integrity of downloaded modules, roles, or plugins before installation or execution.

listener_bind_address.title: Agent Listener Bind Address
listener_bind_address.description: The IP address or hostname the configuration agent's management/reporting port is bound to. A value of '0.0.0.0', '::', or '*' indicates binding to all interfaces.

firewall_restricts_management_port.title: Firewall Restricts Management Port Access
firewall_restricts_management_port.description: Whether a host-level or network firewall rule restricts access to the agent management port to authorized sources only. True means a compensating control is in place.

host_certificate_validation_enforced.title: Host Certificate Validation Enforced
host_certificate_validation_enforced.description: Whether the configuration server strictly validates host TLS client certificates against a trusted CA before issuing configuration payloads.

host_token_validation_mode.title: Host Token Validation Mode
host_token_validation_mode.description: The mode used by the configuration server to validate host identity tokens (e.g., bootstrap tokens, API keys) before issuing configuration.

auto_sign_enabled.title: Automatic Certificate/Node Signing Enabled
auto_sign_enabled.description: Whether the configuration server is configured to automatically sign or accept certificate signing requests or node registrations without manual operator approval.

rollback_mechanism_configured.title: Rollback Mechanism Configured
rollback_mechanism_configured.description: Indicates whether the deployment system has an automated rollback mechanism configured that can revert to a previous known-good state upon deployment failure or health check failure.

rollback_trigger_type.title: Rollback Trigger Type
rollback_trigger_type.description: The type of trigger that initiates a rollback when one is configured: automatic (triggered by health checks or failure conditions), manual (requires human action), or none (no rollback configured).

deployment_history_versions_retained.title: Deployment History Versions Retained
deployment_history_versions_retained.description: The number of previous deployment revisions or snapshots retained by the deployment system, which determines whether a rollback target exists. Zero means no history is kept.

env_vars_passed_as_plaintext_args.title: Environment Variables Passed as Plaintext CLI Arguments
env_vars_passed_as_plaintext_args.description: Indicates whether sensitive environment variables are injected via command-line arguments rather than through secure mechanisms like secrets managers or encrypted vaults, making them visible in process listings.

deployment_output_logging_level.title: Deployment Output Logging Level
deployment_output_logging_level.description: The verbosity level at which deployment runs log their output, including whether environment variable values are captured in log files or CI/CD pipeline artifacts.

shell_history_persistence_disabled.title: Shell History Persistence Disabled on Deployment Hosts
shell_history_persistence_disabled.description: Indicates whether shell history recording is disabled on deployment hosts so that commands containing environment variable values are not persisted to disk.

secrets_manager_integration_used.title: Secrets Manager Integration Used for Sensitive Variables
secrets_manager_integration_used.description: Indicates whether the deployment system retrieves sensitive values at runtime from a dedicated secrets manager (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault) rather than embedding them in deployment configuration or environment.

idempotency_enforcement_enabled.title: Idempotency Enforcement Enabled
idempotency_enforcement_enabled.description: Whether the configuration management tool is configured to enforce idempotent runs, ensuring repeated or interrupted runs converge to the same fully configured state.

security_critical_resources_managed.title: Security-Critical Resources Under Configuration Management
security_critical_resources_managed.description: List of security-critical resource types managed by the configuration tool (e.g., firewall_rules, file_permissions, sudoers, ssh_keys, selinux_policy, audit_rules). If managed without idempotency enforcement, partial runs can leave them insecure.

partial_run_detection_enabled.title: Partial Run Detection / Failure Alerting Enabled
partial_run_detection_enabled.description: Whether the system has a mechanism to detect and alert on incomplete or interrupted configuration runs (e.g., run reports checked for partial completion, health checks after provisioning, or mandatory post-run validation gates).
